documentTypes.name: Invoice
documentTypes.description: Commercial invoices, tax invoices, bills — a request for payment from seller to buyer.

documentTypes.name: Purchase Order
documentTypes.description: A buyer's order authorizing a purchase, or a proforma/packing-list document that serves the same anchoring role.

documentTypes.name: Transaction Record
documentTypes.description: Bank/payment transaction statements, ledger entries, payment confirmations.

documentTypes.name: Receipt
documentTypes.description: Proof of payment for a completed transaction.

documentTypes.name: Unknown
documentTypes.description: Anything that doesn't match a configured document type.

fields.name: documentNumber
fields.description: The primary identifying number for this document — invoice number, receipt number, transaction ID, etc.

fields.name: referenceNumber
fields.description: A purchase-order / reference number this document points back to, or its own PO number if it is the PO document.

fields.name: companyName
fields.description: The issuing company / vendor / merchant name on the document.

fields.name: address
fields.description: A postal address block on the document (issuer or billing address).

fields.name: date
fields.description: The primary date on the document — invoice date, transaction date, order date, etc.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The total / grand-total monetary amount on the document.
